title: Coymans genealogy dataset
descriptions: This dataset was constructed during the NWO VICI project ‘Exploiting the Empires of Others: Dutch Investment in Foreign Colonial Resources, 1570-1800’ at Leiden University. The dataset includes biographical data of 95 individuals, who were part of the Coymans family of the late sixteenth and seventeenth century.
